name: New Scenario Test
description: GUI test of the scenario editor in rpg_plus, without the dev tools: the New button's rule makes scenarios/itest_new_scenario.scenario in the game's mod, a bad name and an existing file are refused, the command palette inserts 'action stat.add stat=str value=2' into the open scenario, Ctrl+S-equivalent saves it, and the file the test made is removed. Activated by --itest=new_scenario with --game=rpg_plus --new.
